name: Island of Death: Demons and Despair
storyline: When they decided to spend their honeymoon on a wonderful island retreat, Natalie and John could not imagine the terrible experiments that would be conducted on them. Right when the couple arrived at the island, demons broke out and attacked the island’s inhabitants and infected everyone with a mysterious disease. Fortunately, Natalie managed to avoid infection. Help Natalie find a way to cure John in Island of Death: Demons and Despair.
